mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_access_token (user_id, token_hash, expires_at, ip, user_agent) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{ip}, #{userAgent})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS token_id, t.user_id FROM sys_access_token t JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.user_id WHERE t.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND t.revoked_at IS NULL AND t.expires_at > #{now} AND u.enabled = TRUE LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_access_token SET revoked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE sys_access_token SET revoked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_access_token WHERE expires_at < #{now} OR (revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at < DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 7 DAY))
